name: MaritimeTrafficAgents

weather.notes: Ocean spectrum wind is a rendering proxy for remote groundswell, NOT the local wind used for drone limits.

water.notes: Synthetic open-water area, not a chart or a bathymetric/official traffic scheme.

fastDrones.notes: Unarmed fictional visual benchmark; no measured military or commercial aircraft performance. Full-episode continuous trajectories, isolated burst captures, no impact or interception.

notes: Every enabled appearance is planned once, not necessarily visible in every frame.
Airliner cruise is around 810-870 km/h at 9.5-11.5 km, not 1000 km/h at low altitude.

Agents negotiate complete routes before launch: straight traffic and bounded smooth-position drone flybys. Unexpected runtime deviation stops the owned run; no teleport or reactive navigation is applied.
No LLM, external API or extra ROS client is used by the planning network.
